titleJa: 育苗箱・ポリポット・セルトレイの形
altJa: 左に浅い長方形の育苗箱、中央に独立した丸いポリポット、右に小区画が一体化して並ぶセルトレイを置いた比較イラスト。
observationJa: 左は縁に囲まれた一つの広い内部、中央は一鉢の丸い開口部と側壁、右は仕切られた多数の小区画を見比べます。同じような色でも、容器の分かれ方が違います。
limitJa: 形を比べるための一例です。色だけで材質を判定しません。寸法・穴数・排水の構造は製品により異なり、この図は播種手順や容器選定の指示ではありません。ペーパーポット、地床育苗、実物写真での全容器識別を扱ったことにはしません。

provenance.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create an original clean 2D educational object illustration for an adult agriculture learning app: three EMPTY nursery containers side by side on a plain white background, left to right, generous gaps, all fully visible with margins. LEFT: a low shallow rectangular seedling nursery box with a broad single continuous open inner floor and low surrounding rim; absolutely no compartment dividers, no individual planting cells. CENTER: one standalone round black nursery pot, tapered sides narrower at base, round open top with a clearly visible empty interior and rolled rim. RIGHT: a rectangular one-piece plug cell tray consisting of a regular grid of separate deep square planting pockets; show the open tops, internal partition walls and a few tapered individual cell bottoms beneath the near edge so its construction is unmistakably different from the flat nursery box. All three are neutral charcoal gray/black, distinguished by shape and construction rather than color. Consistent simple slightly elevated three-quarter view, restrained flat vector-like shading, crisp silhouettes, minimal soft ground shadows, approachable accurate object art, not photorealistic, no brand details, no seedlings, no soil, no people, no paper pots. Do not add ANY text, letters, numbers, labels, arrows or watermarks. This is a newly designed generic arrangement, not a copied textbook illustration. Composition landscape, readable at small mobile size.
